tasks.brief: Implement src/static/index.html for M7. Constraints: synchronous DOM manipulation only; no external libraries beyond what is already in the file; no network requests from this file (it is a static asset); all event handlers must be attached via addEventListener; no inline event attributes (onclick=...). Behavioral specification: 1) data-testid attributes must be set exactly as specified in contracts.ui for all listed elements (new-thread-btn, thread-item, message-input, send-btn, think-toggle, think-content, model-select, msg-user, msg-assistant, unload-nemotron). 2) Implement a stripThinkMarkup(text: string) function that removes all occurrences of  ...  (including unterminated trailing  ...  at stream end) from a string. This function must be used exactly once: when committing the assistant reply to thread.messages on the 'done' SSE event. 3) Implement fetchModels() to capture modelSelect.value before rebuilding the dropdown innerHTML, and restore it afterwards if an option with that value exists; also update the active thread's stored model to the restored value. 4) Preserve the M6 per-thread lock/save/restore mechanism (saveThreadModelState / restoreThreadModelState / per-thread locked flag) without rewriting it. Acceptance condition: The file contains all required data-testid attributes, the stripThinkMarkup function exists and correctly strips  ...  markup, fetchModels() preserves selection, and the M6 lock mechanism is intact.
